items.q: What types of garbage do you collect?
a: We collect all household waste, including general trash, organic waste, recyclables, bulky items, furniture, appliances, renovation debris, and yard waste. Hazardous materials require special handling.

items.q: Do you provide scheduled garbage pickup services?
a: Yes! We offer flexible scheduled pickups, daily, weekly, or monthly, tailored to your needs in residential and commercial properties.

items.q: How much does garbage pickup cost?
a: Prices start at $125 based on volume. Get free instant quotes online or by phone—no hidden fees. Discounts are available for recurring services.

items.q: What areas do you serve for garbage pickup?
a: We serve the surrounding Greater Toronto Area neighborhoods. Contact us to confirm service availability in your exact location.
